# 🚀 Pull Request

## 📝 Description
Brief description of what this PR does

## 🎯 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🌍 Internationalization (language support)
- [ ] 🚀 Raycast enhancement
- [ ] 🤖 AI model improvement

## 🧪 Testing
- [ ] I have tested the changes locally
- [ ] I have tested with Raycast integration (if applicable)
- [ ] I have tested with different languages (if applicable)
- [ ] I have tested the GUI version (if applicable)

## 📋 Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have tested that my changes work with Ollama + Mistral

## 🔧 Ollama/AI Model Testing
If this affects AI functionality:
- [ ] Tested with Mistral model
- [ ] Tested with other models (specify which)
- [ ] Verified offline functionality
- [ ] Tested with multiple languages

## 📸 Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots to help explain your changes

## 🔗 Related Issues
Closes #(issue number)
